It isn't confirmed. She gave no year, 25 August has already passed this year, and she hasn't answered when I asked whether she meant 2027. I suggested he check the year with her before putting it on the account sheet.

- **No contract to check against:** there's still no order form or contract under accounts/tansley-parcel, so I couldn't confirm the date from a document.
- **Saved note not found:** looking up Tansley Parcel in the brain returned nothing, even though it confirmed saving Pree's note on 14 Oct. My answer came from her message in the channel, which Hollis can see too.
